title: Connection with Miao Miao and Huawei P20 Pro fails constantly
body:
We are having Bluetooth connection failures between the Miao Miao and Huawei P20 Pro constantly.
We have already tested several versions of Xdrip.
Some help?

comments.body: I'm using Samsung here & get few disconnections daily, got used to it, however it'll be really bad if I was looped.

Try working through this doc:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rHS_0CmWsTwkL-RnFJWlaHu7KPwVOmTM/view?usp=sharing

I found that turning off Trust Autoconnect was the solution.

The Google Doc link doesn't work anymore. Trust Autoconnect is in xDrip settings - less common settings - Bluetooth settings, in case anyone wondering.

Disabling it at least made xDrip connect on it's own now. I've had to use Tomato app in between and still it disconnected many times a day. Time will tell if this was a perfect workaround :)

@Amtmagalhaes Would you please close this issue if your question has been answered.
You can use the support channels for similar questions.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
